helix-sight-bus.name: Helix Sight Bus
helix-sight-bus.description: Linked sight heads tighten firing solutions and extend observation, but slow movement through clutter.

hammerburst-feed.name: Hammerburst Feed
hammerburst-feed.description: Aggressive feed timing raises impact energy at the cost of crew confidence under sustained fire.

vector-range-lattice.name: Vector Range Lattice
vector-range-lattice.description: Remote ranging extends every firing envelope while exposed emitters weaken protection.

siege-governor.name: Siege Governor
siege-governor.description: A heavy fire-control governor adds force and precision but burdens rapid repositioning.

signal-veil.name: Signal Veil
signal-veil.description: Sensor-diffusing screens add a defensive layer while narrowing the crew sight picture.

impact-cradle.name: Impact Cradle
impact-cradle.description: Stabilized crew stations preserve nerve under shock while their heavy mounts slow relocation.

aegis-baffles.name: Aegis Baffles
aegis-baffles.description: Layered ward baffles reinforce armor and morale but narrow the sensor field.

trailblazer-drive.name: Trailblazer Drive
trailblazer-drive.description: Predictive route control speeds every advance while exposing lighter running protection.

survey-mast.name: Survey Mast
survey-mast.description: An elevated survey array expands battlefield vision but its constant chatter strains cohesion.

relay-harness.name: Relay Harness
relay-harness.description: Distributed relays improve route sharing and sighting while their signal load strains cohesion.

sprint-governor.name: Sprint Governor
sprint-governor.description: Unlocked drive limits enable rapid redeployment at the cost of vision and firing stability.
